## What changed

Describe the product behavior, contract, or documentation change.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository doctor was run from a complete clean checkout.
- [ ] Relevant tests and builds passed.
- [ ] Privacy, schema, migration, compatibility, and maturity impact are stated.

## UI system (when applicable)

- [ ] Existing `@vibemaxxing/ui` components and governed assets were reused.
- [ ] No direct Lucide imports, feature-local SVGs, raw colors, or direct `/brand-assets/` paths were added.
- [ ] New public components include isolated Storybook stories.
- [ ] Desktop, tablet, mobile, exceptional states, keyboard behavior, and accessibility were reviewed.
- [ ] Visual baseline changes are deliberate and the governed manifest was updated.
- [ ] No prototype or fixture was described as production or launch evidence.
